summary: Frontend-only verification of iteration 20: hero search removal, header search trigger overlay, header link cleanup, mobile chip nav reduction (7→5) with underline-indicator restyle, and authenticated TRADE PORTAL/ADMIN CONSOLE clickable header link. ALL 9 requested test cases PASSED on the PREVIEW URL.
critical_code_review_comments: HeaderSearchTrigger.jsx (~104 LOC) is clean — uses ESC handler, body-scroll lock, auto-focus via setTimeout(80ms). Backdrop is a <button> with aria-label so it is accessible. Good z-[60] layering above the sticky header z-30.

MobileScrollSpyChips.jsx underline-indicator restyle is well-implemented (absolute-positioned 2px red bar with width transition from 0→w-5). 5 sections only (hero, joy-beast, experience-centre, tech-stack, bd-news) — chip-value-prop and chip-cta correctly removed.

Layout.jsx header-portal-link uses i18n (t('header.workshop') → 'TRADE PORTAL', t('header.admin') → 'ADMIN CONSOLE'). Renders as Link to /dashboard for workshop and /admin for admin user — matches PRD exactly. Hover transitions to red brand colour.

Landing.jsx header is now lean: only Catalogue link + HeaderSearchTrigger + ThemeToggle + InstallPwaButton + Sign in. Retail Store / Experience Centre / WhatsApp links removed from header (still present in hero CTA buttons and footer — correct).
test_credentials: test-token-workshop-1 (workshop), test-token-admin-1 (admin) — set via localStorage key ja_session_token
